1.  The City Council Meeting was opened to the public. In an effort to keep a safe environment and to minimize the
  spread of the COVID- 19 Virus, the City limited occupancy and required masking for
  those in attendance. To

  facilitate public participation for those who did not wish to attend in person, the meeting was made available
  virtually.

7.  Veterans  of  Foreign  Wars  Council Member Carder stated that she received a request from Daniel Lopez,
  Request  for Placement of a  Commander of the Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 12034 for Council' s
  Chair  of Honor at La Verne  City  consideration in placing a Chair of Honor in the Council Chambers at City Hall.
  Hall  in the Council  Chambers  She reported that the Chair of Honor is in remembrance of over 82, 000 service
  members who have not returned home and are listed as Prisoners of War
  POW) or Missing in Action( MIA). The Chair of Honor serves as a reminder of
  all the sacrifices made for our Country by these American service members.

  The City Council was all in agreement of placing a Chair of Honor in the
  Council Chambers at City Hall and they directed staff to work with the
  Veterans  of Foreign  Wars Post 12034 on this worthy  project.

8  Public Comment  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items not listed in any other place on the agenda.

  Mayor Hepburn  called for public comment.

  There were public comments received. To hear what was said during public
  comment, please visit the City' s website to view the archived Council meeting.

9.  Council  Comments  Council Member Crosby stated he was unable to attend the rally held about
  Afflerbaugh&  Paige Camps on Saturday because he was with family and by
  the time he heard about it, it was too late. He urged the community to stay safe
  during the Super Bowl and" GO RAMS".

  Council Member Lau thanked City staff for their work during the recent
  windstorm. She acknowledged residents who also helped and reached out to
  their  neighbors  during the windstorm.  She stated that La Verne is an amazing
  community.  She reported that the Red Cross is in desperate need of Blood
  and urged people to donate. She wished everyone a happy Lunar Year of the
  Tiger.

  Mayor Pro Tem Davis announced that February was Black History, and
  American  Heart  Month.  He reported on the Active Transportation  Committee.
  He also acknowledged residents for their community spirt in helping each other
  during the recent windstorm.

  Mayor Hepburn thanked all the residents who attended the rally about
  Afflerbaugh& Paige Camps on Saturday. He reported on the Board of

  Supervisors( BOS) and the Department of Juvenile Justice( DOJJ) meetings
  on  the  camp and urged residents
  to  stay vigilant.  He thanked City Manager
  Russi  for his efforts in working with  Edison  during the recent windstorm.
